decisions.choice: Jehoiakim: the name the Hebrew text has here, although the events of the chapter belong to the reign of Zedekiah
alternatives: In the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah
decisions.reason: The envoys come to Zedekiah (verse 3), Jeremiah speaks to Zedekiah (verse 12), and Jeconiah has already been taken to Babylon (verse 20), which happened in 597 BC, after Jehoiakim had died. The next chapter dates the same events "in that year, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year" (28:1). A few Hebrew manuscripts and the Syriac translation read "Zedekiah" here, and the Greek translation has no verse 1 at all. The heading is word for word the one at 26:1, and a copyist may have repeated it from there. The Hebrew is printed as it stands, but the reign meant is probably Zedekiah's.

decisions.choice: the beginning of the reign: the early part of a king's rule
decisions.reason: The phrase need not mean the first months. In 28:1 the same words cover the fourth year of Zedekiah, about 594 BC.

decisions.choice: this word: a heading over the whole chapter, which Jeremiah then tells in his own voice
decisions.reason: From verse 2 Jeremiah speaks of himself ("the LORD said to me", verses 2, 12, 16). The heading introduces three messages on one theme: to the foreign kings (verses 2-11), to Zedekiah (verses 12-15), and to the priests and people (verses 16-22).

decisions.choice: this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying (Literal); this message came to Jeremiah from the LORD (Balanced); the LORD gave Jeremiah this message (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this heading throughout Jeremiah, with "this" as the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: straps and yoke bars: the parts of a yoke such as oxen wore
decisions.reason: A yoke was a wooden bar laid across an animal's neck and tied on with cords or leather straps (Leviticus 26:13; Ezekiel 34:27 name the same two parts). The plural may describe one yoke made of several pieces, or several yokes, since verse 3 sends them to five kings. In 28:10 the prophet Hananiah takes the yoke bar off Jeremiah's neck and breaks it.

decisions.choice: a sign acted out: the yoke on the prophet's neck stands for submission to the king of Babylon
decisions.reason: As with the loincloth (13:1-11) and the clay jar (19:1-13), Jeremiah carries God's message in an action. Verses 8, 11 and 12 say what it means: to put one's neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon is to accept his rule.

decisions.choice: Thus said the LORD to me (Literal); The LORD said this to me (Balanced); This is what the LORD said to me (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 13:1. God's words to Jeremiah open a double quotation mark here, which stays open to the end of verse 11.

decisions.choice: wooden yoke bars and leather straps to tie them
decisions.reason: Readable says what the two parts were made of and how they fit together, so that the reader can picture a yoke.

decisions.choice: "ማሰሪያዎችና የቀንበር ዘንጎች" (straps and yoke bars); yoke "ቀንበር"

decisions.choice: send them: the straps and yoke bars themselves
decisions.reason: "Them" points back to the pieces of the yoke in verse 2, so each king receives the sign along with the message. Some take it more loosely as "send word", but the pronoun has the yoke as its nearest object.

decisions.choice: five neighboring kingdoms whose envoys had gathered in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Edom, Moab and Ammon lay east and south-east of Judah; Tyre and Sidon were the Phoenician ports on the coast to the north. Their envoys at Zedekiah's court were most likely planning a joint revolt against Babylon, about 594 BC (28:1). The same kings are named among those who must drink the cup of God's anger (25:21-22). "The sons of Ammon" is the usual name for the Ammonites.

decisions.choice: the Ammonites (Balanced), Ammon (Readable); envoys (Balanced), messengers (Readable); these kings have sent (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Sons of Ammon" is the people's name. The messengers here are royal ambassadors, so Balanced calls them envoys. Verse 4 calls the kings "their masters", so Readable says the kings had sent them.

decisions.choice: "des enfants d'Ammon", with "fils d'Ammon" as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: As the English sets the same span at Literal; the people of Ammon, men and women, are meant. Balanced and Readable name the people, "les Ammonites", "Ammon".

decisions.choice: сынов Аммона (L); аммонитяне (B); Аммон (R); послы
decisions.reason: "Sons of Ammon" is the people's name, kept at Literal without a gender setting, since the English Literal has none here; the messengers are royal envoys, "послы" at every level.

pt.L: E dá-lhes ordem [de falar] aos seus senhores, dizendo: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Assim vocês dirão aos seus senhores:
pt.B: Dá-lhes esta ordem para os seus senhores: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: É isto que vocês devem dizer aos seus senhores:
pt.R: Manda que eles levem esta mensagem aos seus reis: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, diz: Digam isto aos seus reis:

am.L: ለጌቶቻቸውም [እንዲነግሩ] እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው፦ “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ እንዲህ ይላል፦ ለጌቶቻችሁ እንዲህ ትላላችሁ፦
am.B: ለጌቶቻቸው ይህን መልእክት ስጣቸው፦ “የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ እንዲህ ይላል፦ ለጌቶቻችሁ የምትነግሩት ይህ ነው፦
am.R: ይህን መልእክት ለነገሥታታቸው እንዲያደርሱ ንገራቸው፦ “የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ እንዲህ ይላል፦ ለነገሥታታችሁ እንዲህ በሉ፦

hi.L: और उन्हें उनके स्वामियों के लिए यह आज्ञा दो, कि, 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यों कहते हैं: अपने स्वामियों से तुम यों कहना:
hi.B: उन्हें उनके स्वामियों के लिए यह संदेश दो: 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यह कहते हैं: अपने स्वामियों से तुम यह कहना:
hi.R: उनसे कहो कि यह संदेश अपने राजाओं के पास ले जाएँ: 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, यह कहते हैं: अपने राजाओं से यह कहना:

ru.L: И прикажи им [сказать] их господам, говоря: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Так скажите вашим господам:
ru.B: Дай им такое поручение для их господ: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Вот что вы скажете вашим господам:
ru.R: Скажи им, чтобы они передали это своим царям: “Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, Бог Израиля: Скажите вашим царям так:

ja.L: そして彼らに、彼らの主君たちへ[こう伝えるよう]命じなさい。『万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。あなたがたは、あなたがたの主君たちにこう言え。
ja.B: そして彼らに、主君たちへ伝えるよう、こう命じなさい。『万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。あなたがたは、主君たちにこう言いなさい。
ja.R: そして、その使いの者たちに、次のことを王たちに伝えるよう言いなさい。『天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。あなたたちの王たちにこう言いなさい。

uk.L: І накажи їм [сказати] їхнім панам, кажучи: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, Бог Ізраїля: Так скажіть вашим панам:
uk.B: Дай їм таке доручення для їхніх панів: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, Бог Ізраїля: Ось що ви маєте сказати вашим панам:
uk.R: Скажи їм передати своїм царям таке послання: “Ось що каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, Бог Ізраїлю: Скажіть вашим царям таке:

decisions.choice: their masters: the kings who sent the envoys
decisions.reason: The word is used of a lord or master, and of a king by those who serve him. The envoys are their kings' servants.

decisions.choice: three layers of speech: God to Jeremiah, Jeremiah to the envoys, the envoys to their kings
decisions.reason: God tells Jeremiah what to say to the envoys (verses 2-11). Jeremiah gives them the LORD's words, which they are to repeat to their kings (verses 5-11).

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, speaks to foreign kings
decisions.reason: The God of a small kingdom gives orders to the rulers of its neighbors. Verse 5 gives the reason he can: he made the earth and gives it to whom he chooses.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks for the message given to the envoys, to the end of verse 11; no further marks for the words to the kings
decisions.reason: God's words to Jeremiah are already in double marks, so the message Jeremiah passes on takes single marks. The words the envoys are to repeat follow "Say this to your masters" after a colon, as God's words follow "Thus says the LORD" elsewhere in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: command them [to speak] to (Literal); give them this charge for (Balanced); tell them to take this message to their kings (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Command them to their masters" means to give the envoys a message to carry home. Readable says "kings" for "masters" (see m1).

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, Balanced and Readable say "Armies" for "hosts" (see Isaiah 1:9).

decisions.choice: “ ” for the message given to the envoys, to the end of verse 11
decisions.reason: Three layers of speech (meaning decision m2): the LORD's words to Jeremiah take « », the message for the envoys “ ”, and the words the envoys are to repeat to their kings take no further marks, as the English does.

decisions.choice: « » for the LORD's words to Jeremiah (verses 2-11), “ ” for the message to the envoys, ‘ ’ for the words quoted inside it (verse 9)
decisions.reason: Three layers of speech, as meaning decision m2 says; French uses its usual order of marks, as Exodus 7:16 does for a third level.

decisions.choice: quotation marks as in the English; God says "các ngươi" to the envoys and their kings
decisions.reason: God speaks to foreign kings and their envoys as "ngươi" / "các ngươi" at every level (terms note, after 2 Kings 19:21-28). The words to the kings run on without new quotation marks, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L); "... 이렇게 말씀하신다" (B); "... 하시는 말씀이다" (R), with the honorific, though the formula stands inside God's words to Jeremiah
alternatives: "주가 이와 같이 말한다" (God naming himself plainly)
decisions.reason: One rule for Isaiah, Jeremiah and Ezra: the messenger formula keeps the honorific even where God dictates the message, as published at 1 Kings 21:19, 2 Samuel 7:5 and 1 Chronicles 17:4; God's own words that follow stay in the plain style, without -시- for himself.

decisions.choice: तुम to the envoys
decisions.reason: God's message addresses the foreign envoys with तुम, as God addresses people throughout; the envoys' masters are स्वामी at L and B, राजा at R, as the English says "kings".

decisions.choice: 'adoneihem "主君たち" (L, B), "王たち" (R); YHWH tseva'ot "万軍の{D}" (L, B), "天の軍勢を率いる{D}" (R).
decisions.reason: m1; JER conventions.

decisions.choice: 『』 for the message the envoys carry, opened here and closed at 27:11, inside 「」; the message's commands "言え" (L), "言いなさい" (B, R); God calls the envoys あなたがた (L, B), あなたたち (R).

records.literal_gloss: I, I made the earth, the human and the animal which [are] on [the] face of the earth, by my power the great and by my arm the outstretched, and I give it to whom it is right in my eyes.

en.L: I made the earth, {{gender:humankind|man}} and the animals that [are] on the face of the earth, by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great power and by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} outstretched arm, and I give it to whomever it is right in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes.
en.B: It is I who made the earth, and the people and animals that live on it, by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great power and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} outstretched arm, and I give it to anyone I see fit.
en.R: I made the earth, and the people and animals that live on it. I did it by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great power and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} strong arm. And I give the earth to anyone I choose.

es.L: Yo hice la tierra, al ser humano y a los animales que [están] sobre la faz de la tierra, con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran poder y con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} brazo extendido, y la doy a quien es recto ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos.
es.B: Soy yo quien hizo la tierra, y a la gente y los animales que viven en ella, con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran poder y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} brazo extendido, y se la doy a quien me parece bien.
es.R: Yo hice la tierra, y a la gente y los animales que viven en ella. Lo hice con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran poder y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} brazo fuerte. Y le doy la tierra a quien yo quiero.

fr.L: C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai fait la terre, {{gender:l’humain|l’homme}} et les bêtes qui [sont] sur la face de la terre, par {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande puissance et par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} bras étendu, et je la donne à qui il est juste à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai fait la terre, ainsi que les humains et les bêtes qui vivent sur elle, par {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande puissance et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} bras étendu, et je la donne à qui je juge bon.
fr.R: J’ai fait la terre, ainsi que les gens et les animaux qui vivent sur elle. Je l’ai fait par {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande puissance et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} bras puissant. Et je donne la terre à qui je veux.

sw.L: Mimi nimeiumba dunia, wanadamu na wanyama walio juu ya uso wa dunia, kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kuu na kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ulionyoshwa, nami ninaitoa kwa yeyote aliye sawa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}.
sw.B: Ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niliyeiumba dunia, na watu na wanyama wanaoishi juu yake, kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kuu na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ulionyoshwa, nami ninaitoa kwa yeyote ninayeona inafaa.
sw.R: Mimi niliiumba dunia, na watu na wanyama wanaoishi juu yake. Niliifanya kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kuu na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wenye nguvu. Nami ninaitoa dunia kwa yeyote ninayemchagua.

vi.L: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm nên đất, loài người và thú vật ở trên mặt đất, bằng quyền năng lớn và cánh tay giơ ra của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban nó cho bất cứ ai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thấy là đúng.
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm nên đất, cùng loài người và thú vật sống trên đất, bằng quyền năng lớn lao và cánh tay giơ ra của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban đất ấy cho bất cứ ai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thấy xứng hợp.
vi.R: Ta đã làm nên đất, cùng loài người và thú vật sống trên đất. Ta đã làm điều ấy bằng quyền năng lớn lao và cánh tay mạnh mẽ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban đất cho bất cứ ai {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn.

ko.L: 내가 내 큰 능력과 내가 뻗은 팔로 땅과 땅 위에 있는 사람과 짐승을 만들었다. 그리고 나는 내 눈에 옳게 보이는 자에게 그것을 준다.
ko.B: 바로 내가 내 큰 능력과 내가 뻗은 팔로 땅을 만들고, 땅 위에 사는 사람과 짐승을 만들었다. 나는 내가 보기에 마땅한 사람에게 그것을 준다.
ko.R: 내가 땅을 만들었다. 땅 위에 사는 사람과 짐승도 만들었다. 나는 내 큰 능력과 강한 팔로 그 일을 했다. 그리고 나는 내가 고른 사람에게 땅을 준다.

pt.L: Eu fiz a terra, {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}} e os animais que [estão] sobre a face da terra, com o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} grande poder e com o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} braço estendido, e a dou a quem é reto aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos.
pt.B: Fui eu que fiz a terra, e as pessoas e os animais que vivem nela, com o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} grande poder e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} braço estendido, e eu a dou a quem eu achar melhor.
pt.R: Eu fiz a terra, e as pessoas e os animais que vivem nela. Fiz isso com o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} grande poder e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} braço forte. E eu dou a terra a quem eu escolher.

am.L: ምድርን፣ በምድርም ፊት ላይ ያሉትን ሰውንና እንስሳን በታላቅ ኃይሌና በተዘረጋው ክንዴ የሠራሁ እኔ ነኝ፤ በዓይኔም ቅን ለሆነለት እሰጣታለሁ።
am.B: ምድርን፣ በእርሷም ላይ የሚኖሩትን ሰዎችንና እንስሳትን በታላቅ ኃይሌና በተዘረጋው ክንዴ የሠራሁ እኔ ነኝ፤ ለመረጥኩትም ሰው እሰጣታለሁ።
am.R: ምድርንና በእርሷ ላይ የሚኖሩትን ሰዎችና እንስሳት የሠራሁ እኔ ነኝ። ይህን ያደረግኩት በታላቅ ኃይሌና በብርቱ ክንዴ ነው። ምድርንም ለፈለግኩት ሰው እሰጣለሁ።

hi.L: मैंने ही पृथ्वी को, और पृथ्वी की सतह पर [रहनेवाले] मनुष्यों और पशुओं को, अपनी बड़ी शक्ति और अपनी बढ़ाई हुई भुजा से बनाया, और जिसे मेरी दृष्टि में ठीक लगे, उसी को मैं उसे देता हूँ।
hi.B: मैंने ही अपनी बड़ी शक्ति और अपनी बढ़ाई हुई भुजा से पृथ्वी को, और उस पर रहनेवाले मनुष्यों और पशुओं को बनाया है, और जिसे मैं उचित समझता हूँ उसे मैं उसे दे देता हूँ।
hi.R: मैंने पृथ्वी को, और उस पर रहनेवाले लोगों और पशुओं को बनाया। मैंने यह अपनी बड़ी शक्ति और अपनी बलवान भुजा से किया। और जिसे मैं चाहता हूँ, उसी को मैं यह पृथ्वी देता हूँ।

ru.L: Я сотворил землю, человека и животных, которые на лице земли, {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} великой силой и {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} простёртой рукой, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отдаю её, кому правильно в {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глазах.
ru.B: Это {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сотворил землю, людей и животных, которые живут на ней, {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} великой силой и {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} простёртой рукой, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отдаю её тому, кому считаю нужным.
ru.R: Я сотворил землю, людей и животных, которые живут на ней. Я сделал это {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} великой силой и {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} могучей рукой. И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отдаю землю тому, кому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хочу.

ja.L: わたしこそが、わたしの大いなる力と、わたしの伸ばした腕によって、地と、地の面にいる人と獣を造った。そして、わたしの目に正しいと思われる者に、それを与える。
ja.B: わたしこそ、大いなる力と伸ばした腕によって、地と、地の上にいる人と動物を造った者だ。わたしは、自分が良いと思う者にそれを与える。
ja.R: わたしが、大きな力と強い腕で、地と、そこに住む人と動物を造った。そして、わたしは、自分が選んだ者に、その地を与える。

uk.L: Я створив землю, людину і тварин, що на поверхні землі, {{deity_pronoun:моєю|Моєю}} великою силою і {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} простягненим раменом, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} даю її тому, хто слушний у {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} очах.
uk.B: Це {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} створив землю, і людей, і тварин, що живуть на ній, {{deity_pronoun:моєю|Моєю}} великою силою і {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} простягненим раменом, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} даю її тому, кому вважаю за слушне.
uk.R: Я створив землю, і людей, і тварин, що живуть на ній. Я зробив це {{deity_pronoun:моєю|Моєю}} великою силою і {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} сильним раменом. І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} даю землю тому, кому захочу.

decisions.choice: I: written out and placed first, for emphasis
decisions.reason: The pronoun is not needed with the verb, so it stresses the speaker: it is the Creator who speaks, and his right to give the earth away rests on his having made it.

decisions.choice: great power and outstretched arm: God's strength at work
decisions.reason: The words recall the exodus, where God brought Israel out "with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm" (Deuteronomy 4:34; 9:29). Jeremiah uses the same pair of creation in 32:17.

decisions.choice: to whomever it is right in my eyes: to whomever I judge fit
decisions.reason: "In my eyes" means "in my judgment". Rule over the earth is God's gift, given as he decides. Daniel 4:14 says the same of the Most High, who gives kingship to whom he wishes.

decisions.choice: anyone I see fit (Balanced); anyone I choose (Readable)
decisions.reason: The idiom of the eyes becomes plain English for judging or choosing. Balanced keeps the emphasis of verse 5 with "It is I who".

decisions.choice: strong arm
decisions.reason: Readable says "strong" because a stretched-out arm is a picture of strength put to work.

decisions.choice: al ser humano
decisions.reason: Literal says "el ser humano" for *ha'adam*, which already includes women, so no gender span is needed where the English has one.

decisions.choice: "l'humain", with "l'homme" as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: As the published French books (l'humain|l'homme) for 'adam, humankind; Balanced and Readable say "les humains", "les gens", which need no alternative.

decisions.choice: "loài người" (humankind) with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "loài người" already names all people, so the English Literal's gender alternative ("man") has no second Vietnamese wording.

decisions.choice: "사람", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "사람" already means human beings of both sexes, so Korean has no second wording for the English gender setting.

decisions.choice: No gender span on "ሰው"
decisions.reason: "ሰው" already means a human being, man or woman, so the English humankind/man setting has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: मनुष्य, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "humankind / man" under the gender setting. Hindi मनुष्य already means human beings of either sex, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: no gender span on "человека"
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span for "humankind / man"; Russian "человек" for the human race already covers men and women, so the span is not carried over.

decisions.choice: ha'adam "人" with no gender span, where the English L has humankind/man.
decisions.reason: Japanese is already inclusive (style 7a).

decisions.choice: 'anokhi "わたしこそ" (L, B) for the fronted pronoun (m1); zeroa' netuyah "伸ばした腕" (L, B), "強い腕" (R), as EXO 6:6.
decisions.reason: m1, m2; the EXO form.

en.L: And now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant; and even the animals of the field I have given to him to serve him.

es.L: Y ahora yo he entregado todas estas tierras en mano de Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo; y aun las bestias del campo le he dado para que le sirvan.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, j’ai livré tous ces pays entre les mains de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur ; et même les bêtes des champs, je les lui ai données pour qu’elles le servent.
fr.B: Maintenant, j’ai livré tous ces pays à Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur. Je lui ai même donné les bêtes sauvages pour qu’elles le servent.
fr.R: Maintenant, j’ai mis tous ces pays sous le pouvoir de Nabuchodonosor, le roi de Babylone. C’est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur. Je lui ai même donné les animaux sauvages, pour qu’ils le servent eux aussi.

sw.L: Na sasa nimeitia nchi hizi zote mkononi mwa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; na hata wanyama wa porini nimempa ili wamtumikie.

vi.L: Giờ đây {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phó mọi xứ này vào tay Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, đầy tớ Ta; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng ban cho vua ấy cả thú vật ngoài đồng để phục dịch vua.

pt.L: E agora eu entreguei todas estas terras na mão de Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo; e também os animais do campo eu lhe dei para que o sirvam.

uk.R: Тепер {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} віддав усі ці країни під владу Навуходоносора, царя Вавилону. Він {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} раб. Я дав йому навіть диких звірів, щоб і вони служили йому.

decisions.choice: my servant: Nebuchadnezzar as the one through whom God carries out his purpose
decisions.reason: The title does not mean that the king worshiped Israel's God. It means he does God's work, here the work of judgment, as in 25:9 and 43:10. Isaiah speaks in the same way of Assyria as the rod of God's anger (Isaiah 10:5-7) and of Cyrus as his anointed (Isaiah 45:1).

decisions.choice: I have given: a decision already made and now in force
decisions.reason: The verb describes God's gift as settled. It can also be read as a present, "I am giving"; either way, the lands are already in the king's hand by God's will. "And now" turns from creation (verse 5) to the present moment.

decisions.choice: even the animals of the field: his rule reaches everything, even wild creatures
decisions.reason: The animals of the field are the wild animals, as against the herds. Giving them to the king shows how complete his rule is meant to be (28:14; Daniel 2:38).

decisions.choice: Nebuchadnezzar: the form of the name used in this chapter
decisions.reason: Jeremiah usually spells the name Nebuchadrezzar (21:2; 25:9), closer to its Babylonian form, Nabu-kudurri-usur. Chapters 27-29 use Nebuchadnezzar, as Kings does. Both name the same king, who ruled Babylon from 605 to 562 BC.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: As in 7:25, "servant" is kept at every level for one who serves God's purpose; it describes his role, not ownership by a master.

decisions.choice: handed ... over to (Balanced), put ... under the power of (Readable); wild animals
decisions.reason: "Into the hand of" means into someone's control. "The animals of the field" are the wild animals.

decisions.choice: Nabucodonosor
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this chapter has the form with -n- (meaning decision m4), so every level writes the usual "Nabucodonosor"; chapters with the -r- form have "Nabucodorosor".

decisions.choice: Nebukadneza
decisions.reason: In chapters 27-29 the Hebrew spells the king's name with n, so Swahili uses "Nebukadneza" as Kings does, where 21-25 had "Nebukadreza"; he is the same king.

decisions.choice: "Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa", the published form, where the Hebrew has the form with n
decisions.reason: This chapter's Hebrew spells the name with n, so the published form of 2 Kings is used; elsewhere in these chapters the form with r is "Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa" (21:2). He is "đầy tớ Ta" at every level, as 25:9.

decisions.choice: "느부갓네살"
decisions.reason: This chapter's Hebrew has the form Nebuchadnezzar (meaning decision m4), so Korean uses the published form of 2 Kings here; each verse keeps its own form, as the terms note says.

decisions.choice: Nabucodonosor
decisions.reason: Chapters 27-29 spell the name with an n (m4), and the English writes "Nebuchadnezzar" here, so Portuguese writes "Nabucodonosor", the form of 2 Kings, as set at 21:2.

decisions.choice: "ናቡከደነፆር"; "ባሪያዬ" / "አገልጋዬ" (my servant)
decisions.reason: The book keeps one Amharic form of the name whether the Hebrew spells it with n (as here) or r; my servant as in 25:9.

decisions.choice: नबूकदनेस्सर; मेरा दास
decisions.reason: This chapter's Hebrew spells the name with n, so it is नबूकदनेस्सर, the form of Kings, Chronicles and Daniel; 24:1 and 25 keep नबूकदरेस्सर where the Hebrew has r. "My servant" is दास, as at 25:9.

decisions.choice: Навуходоносор; моего раба
decisions.reason: This chapter's Hebrew spells the name Nebuchadnezzar, so Russian has Навуходоносор, as Kings and Daniel, kept apart from Навуходорносор in chapter 25. He is God's ʿeved, "раб" at every level, as in 25:9.

decisions.choice: Nevukhadne'tsar "ネブカドネツァル" (the one JER form); 'avdi "わたしのしもべ" at every level, as 25:9; chayyat hassadeh "野の獣" (L, B), "野の動物" (R).
decisions.reason: m1, m4; JER conventions.

source.text: וְעָבְד֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶת־בְּנ֖וֹ וְאֶֽת־בֶּן־בְּנ֑וֹ עַ֣ד בֹּא־עֵ֤ת אַרְצוֹ֙ גַּם־ה֔וּא וְעָ֤בְדוּ בוֹ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּמְלָכִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will serve him all the nations, and his son and [the] son of his son, until comes [the] time of his land, also he; and will make serve by him nations many and kings great.

en.L: And all the nations shall serve him and his son and his son's son, until the time of his own land comes, [his] also; and then many nations and great kings shall make him serve [them].
en.B: All the nations will serve him and his son and his grandson, until the time comes for his own land as well. Then many nations and great kings will make him serve them.
en.R: All the nations will serve him, and his son and his grandson after him. But a time will come for his own country too. Then many nations and powerful kings will make Babylon serve them.

es.L: Y todas las naciones le servirán a él, a su hijo y al hijo de su hijo, hasta que llegue también el tiempo de su propia tierra; y entonces muchas naciones y grandes reyes lo harán su siervo.
es.B: Todas las naciones le servirán a él, a su hijo y a su nieto, hasta que llegue también el tiempo de su propia tierra. Entonces muchas naciones y grandes reyes lo harán servirles.
es.R: Todas las naciones le servirán a él, y a su hijo y a su nieto después de él. Pero llegará el tiempo también para su propio país. Entonces muchas naciones y reyes poderosos harán que Babilonia les sirva.

fr.L: Et toutes les nations le serviront, lui, et son fils, et le fils de son fils, jusqu’à ce que vienne le temps de son pays, à lui aussi ; et alors des nations nombreuses et de grands rois l’asserviront.
fr.B: Toutes les nations le serviront, lui, son fils et son petit-fils, jusqu’à ce que vienne aussi le temps de son propre pays. Alors des nations nombreuses et de grands rois l’asserviront à leur tour.
fr.R: Toutes les nations le serviront, lui, puis son fils et son petit-fils après lui. Mais un temps viendra aussi pour son propre pays. Alors beaucoup de nations et des rois puissants obligeront Babylone à les servir.

sw.L: Na mataifa yote watamtumikia yeye, na mwanawe, na mwana wa mwanawe, mpaka wakati wa nchi yake mwenyewe utakapofika, [yake] pia; ndipo mataifa mengi na wafalme wakuu watamtumikisha.
sw.B: Mataifa yote yatamtumikia yeye na mwanawe na mjukuu wake, mpaka wakati wa nchi yake mwenyewe pia utakapofika. Ndipo mataifa mengi na wafalme wakuu watamfanya awatumikie.
sw.R: Mataifa yote yatamtumikia yeye, na mwanawe na mjukuu wake baada yake. Lakini wakati utafika kwa nchi yake pia. Ndipo mataifa mengi na wafalme wenye nguvu wataifanya Babeli iwatumikie.

vi.L: Mọi dân tộc sẽ phục dịch vua ấy, con trai vua và cháu trai vua, cho đến khi thời kỳ của xứ vua cũng đến; bấy giờ nhiều dân tộc và các vua lớn sẽ bắt vua phục dịch [họ].
vi.B: Mọi dân tộc sẽ phục dịch vua ấy, con trai và cháu trai vua, cho đến khi thời kỳ của chính xứ vua cũng đến. Bấy giờ nhiều dân tộc và các vua lớn sẽ bắt vua phục dịch họ.
vi.R: Mọi dân tộc sẽ phục dịch vua ấy, rồi con trai và cháu trai vua sau này. Nhưng rồi thời kỳ của chính xứ vua ấy cũng sẽ đến. Bấy giờ nhiều dân tộc và các vua hùng mạnh sẽ bắt Ba-by-lôn phục dịch họ.

ko.L: 그리고 모든 민족이 그와 그의 아들과 그의 손자를 섬길 것이다. 그의 땅의 때도 올 때까지 [그럴 것이다]. 그때에는 많은 민족과 큰 왕들이 그를 [그들의] 종으로 부릴 것이다.
ko.B: 모든 민족이 그와 그의 아들과 손자를 섬길 것이다. 그러다가 그의 나라에도 때가 올 것이다. 그때에는 많은 민족과 큰 왕들이 그를 종으로 부릴 것이다.
ko.R: 모든 민족이 그를 섬길 것이다. 그 뒤에는 그의 아들과 손자를 섬길 것이다. 그러나 그의 나라에도 때가 올 것이다. 그때에는 많은 민족과 강한 왕들이 바빌론을 종으로 부릴 것이다.

pt.L: E todas as nações o servirão, a ele, e ao seu filho, e ao filho do seu filho, até que venha o tempo da sua [própria] terra, também [a dele]; e então muitas nações e grandes reis o farão servi-los.
pt.B: Todas as nações servirão a ele, ao seu filho e ao seu neto, até que chegue também o tempo da sua própria terra. Então muitas nações e grandes reis o farão servi-los.
pt.R: Todas as nações vão servir a ele, e ao seu filho e ao seu neto depois dele. Mas vai chegar o tempo também para o país dele. Então muitas nações e reis poderosos vão fazer a Babilônia servi-los.

am.L: የገዛ ምድሩ ጊዜ፣ [የእርሱም] ደግሞ፣ እስኪመጣ ድረስ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ እርሱንና ልጁን የልጁንም ልጅ ያገለግላሉ፤ ከዚያም ብዙ ሕዝቦችና ታላላቅ ነገሥታት እርሱን ያስገዙታል።
am.B: የገዛ ምድሩ ጊዜ እስኪደርስ ድረስ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ እርሱንና ልጁን የልጅ ልጁንም ያገለግላሉ። ከዚያም ብዙ ሕዝቦችና ታላላቅ ነገሥታት እርሱን ያስገዙታል።
am.R: ሕዝቦች ሁሉ እርሱን፣ ከእርሱም በኋላ ልጁንና የልጅ ልጁን ያገለግላሉ። ነገር ግን ለአገሩም ጊዜ ይመጣል። ያን ጊዜ ብዙ ሕዝቦችና ኃያላን ነገሥታት ባቢሎንን ያስገዟታል።

hi.L: और सब जातियाँ उसकी, और उसके पुत्र की, और उसके पोते की सेवा करेंगी, जब तक उसके अपने देश का भी समय न आए; तब बहुत सी जातियाँ और बड़े बड़े राजा उससे [अपनी] सेवा करवाएँगे।
hi.B: सब देश उसकी, उसके पुत्र की और उसके पोते की सेवा करेंगे, जब तक उसके अपने देश का भी समय न आ जाए। तब बहुत से देश और बड़े बड़े राजा उससे अपनी सेवा करवाएँगे।
hi.R: सब देश उसकी सेवा करेंगे, और उसके बाद उसके बेटे और उसके पोते की भी। पर उसके अपने देश का भी समय आएगा। तब बहुत से देश और शक्तिशाली राजा बाबुल से अपनी सेवा करवाएँगे।

ru.L: И будут служить ему все народы, и его сыну, и сыну его сына, пока не придёт время и его земли; и тогда поработят его многие народы и великие цари.
ru.B: Все народы будут служить ему, его сыну и его внуку, пока не придёт время и для его собственной земли. Тогда многие народы и великие цари заставят его служить им.
ru.R: Все народы будут служить ему, а потом его сыну и его внуку. Но придёт время и для его страны. Тогда многие народы и могущественные цари заставят Вавилон служить им.

ja.L: すべての国々は、彼と、彼の子と、彼の子の子に仕える。彼の地の時が、彼自身にも来るまで[である]。そのとき、多くの国々と大いなる王たちが、彼を[自分たちに]仕えさせる。
ja.B: すべての国々は、彼とその子とその孫に仕える。しかし、やがて彼自身の国にも、その時が来る。そのとき、多くの国々と大いなる王たちが、彼を自分たちに仕えさせる。
ja.R: すべての国は、彼にも、その後の彼の息子と孫にも仕える。しかし、彼自身の国にもその時が来る。そのとき、多くの国と力のある王たちが、バビロンを自分たちに仕えさせる。

uk.L: І всі народи служитимуть йому, і його синові, і синові його сина, аж поки не прийде час і його власного краю; і тоді багато народів і великі царі змусять його служити [їм].
uk.B: Усі народи служитимуть йому, і його синові, і його онукові, аж поки не настане час і для його власного краю. Тоді багато народів і великі царі змусять його служити їм.
uk.R: Усі народи служитимуть йому, а після нього його синові й онукові. Але настане час і для його власної країни. Тоді багато народів і могутні царі змусять Вавилон служити їм.

decisions.choice: his son and his son's son: the generations after him, a long but limited span
decisions.reason: The phrase sets a limit on Babylon's power: it will last into the time of his descendants and then end. Babylon fell to Cyrus of Persia in 539 BC, about two generations after Nebuchadnezzar came to power. Jeremiah elsewhere speaks of seventy years (25:11-12; 29:10).

decisions.choice: the time of his land, his too: the time when his own land's turn comes
decisions.reason: "Also he" stresses that Babylon will not escape: as it judged others, its own time of judgment will come (25:12-14; chapters 50-51).

decisions.choice: make him serve: reduce him to service
decisions.reason: The verb "serve" with this preposition means to make someone work for you as a servant or a subject people (25:14; 30:8; Exodus 1:14). The king who made the nations serve will in turn be made to serve. "Him" is the king standing for his kingdom.

decisions.choice: verse 7 is part of the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Greek translation has no verse 7. Jeremiah in Greek is shorter in many places (see 1:1). The Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: a time will come for his own country too; Babylon
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "a time will come" and lets the next sentence say what that time is. It says "Babylon" for "him", since the king stands for his kingdom (see m3).

decisions.choice: 'et 'artso gam hu' "彼の地の時が、彼自身にも来る" (L), "彼自身の国にも、その時が来る" (B, R); 'avedu vo "彼を仕えさせる" (L, B), with Babylon named at R as the English R.

source.text: וְהָיָ֨ה הַגּ֜וֹי וְהַמַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יַעַבְד֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶת־נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֵ֨ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִתֵּן֙ אֶת־צַוָּאר֔וֹ בְּעֹ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל בַּחֶרֶב֩ וּבָרָעָ֨ב וּבַדֶּ֜בֶר אֶפְקֹ֨ד עַל־הַגּ֤וֹי הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה עַד־תֻּמִּ֥י אֹתָ֖ם בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, the nation and the kingdom which not they will serve him, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and which not it will put its neck in [the] yoke of [the] king of Babylon, by the sword and by the famine and by the pestilence I will visit upon the nation the that, declaration of Yahweh, until I have consumed them by his hand.

en.L: And it shall be [that] the nation or the kingdom that will not serve him, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, with the sword and with famine and with pestilence I will punish that nation, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, until I have finished them off by his hand.
en.B: Any nation or kingdom that will not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and will not put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will punish with sword, famine and plague, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, until I have finished it off by his hand.
en.R: But suppose a nation or kingdom refuses to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and will not put its neck under his yoke by accepting his rule. Then I will punish that nation with war, famine and disease, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will use him to destroy it completely.

es.L: Y sucederá que a la nación o al reino que no sirva a él, a Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, y que no ponga su cuello bajo el yugo del rey de Babilonia, con espada, con hambre y con peste castigaré a esa nación, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, hasta que la haya acabado por medio de su mano.
es.B: A cualquier nación o reino que no sirva a Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, y que no ponga su cuello bajo el yugo del rey de Babilonia, la castigaré con la espada, el hambre y la peste, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, hasta acabar con ella por medio de él.
es.R: Pero supongamos que una nación o un reino se niega a servir a Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, y no quiere poner su cuello bajo su yugo aceptando su gobierno. Entonces castigaré a esa nación con la guerra, el hambre y las enfermedades, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Lo usaré a él para destruirla por completo.

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] la nation ou le royaume qui ne le servira pas, lui, Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, et qui ne mettra pas son cou sous le joug du roi de Babylone, par l’épée, par la famine et par la peste je punirai cette nation, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, jusqu’à ce que je les aie achevés par sa main.
fr.B: La nation ou le royaume qui ne voudra pas servir Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, et ne mettra pas son cou sous le joug du roi de Babylone, je le punirai par l’épée, la famine et la peste, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, jusqu’à ce que je l’aie achevé par sa main.
fr.R: Mais supposons qu’une nation ou un royaume refuse de servir Nabuchodonosor, le roi de Babylone, et refuse de mettre son cou sous son joug en acceptant son autorité. Alors je punirai cette nation par la guerre, la famine et la maladie, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je me servirai de lui pour la détruire complètement.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, taifa au ufalme usiotaka kumtumikia yeye, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, na usiotia shingo yake chini ya nira ya mfalme wa Babeli, kwa upanga na kwa njaa na kwa tauni nitaliadhibu taifa hilo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mpaka nitakapowamaliza kwa mkono wake.
sw.B: Taifa lolote au ufalme wowote usiotaka kumtumikia Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, wala kutia shingo yake chini ya nira ya mfalme wa Babeli, nitaliadhibu kwa upanga, njaa na tauni, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mpaka nitakapolimaliza kwa mkono wake.
sw.R: Lakini tuseme taifa au ufalme fulani unakataa kumtumikia Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, wala hautaki kutia shingo yake chini ya nira yake kwa kukubali utawala wake. Ndipo nitaliadhibu taifa hilo kwa vita, njaa na magonjwa, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nitamtumia yeye kuliangamiza kabisa.

vi.L: Dân tộc hay vương quốc nào không chịu phục dịch vua ấy, là Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, và không chịu đặt cổ mình dưới ách của vua Ba-by-lôn, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phạt dân tộc ấy bằng gươm, nạn đói và ôn dịch, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dùng tay vua ấy tiêu diệt chúng.
vi.B: Dân tộc hay vương quốc nào không chịu phục dịch Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn và không chịu đặt cổ mình dưới ách của vua Ba-by-lôn, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phạt dân tộc ấy bằng gươm đao, nạn đói và dịch bệnh, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dùng tay vua ấy tiêu diệt nó.
vi.R: Nhưng giả sử có một dân tộc hay vương quốc không chịu phục dịch Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn và không chịu đặt cổ mình dưới ách của vua ấy, tức là không chịu để vua ấy cai trị. Thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phạt dân tộc ấy bằng chiến tranh, nạn đói và bệnh tật, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta sẽ dùng vua ấy để tiêu diệt dân tộc ấy hoàn toàn.

ko.L: 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살을 섬기지 않고, 바빌론 왕의 멍에에 자기 목을 넣지 않는 민족이나 나라가 있으면, 내가 그 민족을 칼과 기근과 전염병으로 벌하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 그의 손으로 그들을 다 멸할 때까지 [그렇게 하겠다].
ko.B: 어떤 민족이나 나라든지 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살을 섬기지 않고 바빌론 왕의 멍에를 목에 메지 않으면, 내가 그 민족을 칼과 기근과 전염병으로 벌하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 그의 손을 빌려 그 민족을 완전히 없앨 때까지 그렇게 하겠다.
ko.R: 어떤 민족이나 나라가 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살을 섬기기를 거절하고, 그의 다스림을 받아들여 그의 멍에를 메지 않는다고 하자. 그러면 내가 그 민족을 전쟁과 굶주림과 질병으로 벌하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 그를 시켜 그 민족을 완전히 멸망시키겠다.

pt.L: E acontecerá [que] a nação ou o reino que não o servir, a ele, Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, e que não puser o seu pescoço debaixo do jugo do rei da Babilônia, com a espada, com a fome e com a peste castigarei aquela nação, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, até que eu os tenha consumido pela mão dele.
pt.B: A nação ou o reino que não servir Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, e não puser o pescoço debaixo do jugo do rei da Babilônia, eu castigarei com a espada, a fome e a peste, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, até que eu o tenha acabado pela mão dele.
pt.R: Mas pode ser que uma nação ou reino se recuse a servir Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, e não ponha o pescoço debaixo do jugo dele, aceitando o seu governo. Então vou castigar essa nação com a guerra, a fome e a doença, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Vou usar Nabucodonosor para destruí-la completamente.

am.L: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እርሱን የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን የማያገለግለውን፣ አንገቱንም ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች የማያስገባውን ሕዝብና መንግሥት፣ ያን ሕዝብ በእርሱ እጅ እስካጠፋቸው ድረስ በሰይፍ፣ በራብና በቸነፈር እቀጣዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን የማያገለግልን፣ አንገቱንም ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር የማያስገዛን ሕዝብ ወይም መንግሥት በእርሱ እጅ እስካጠፋው ድረስ በሰይፍ፣ በራብና በቸነፈር እቀጣዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ነገር ግን አንድ ሕዝብ ወይም መንግሥት የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን ለማገልገል እምቢ ቢል፣ የእርሱንም አገዛዝ ተቀብሎ አንገቱን ከቀንበሩ በታች ባያስገባ፣ ያን ሕዝብ በሰይፍ፣ በራብና በቸነፈር እቀጣዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። እርሱን ተጠቅሜ ፈጽሜ አጠፋዋለሁ።

hi.L: और ऐसा होगा [कि] जो जाति या राज्य उसकी, बाबुल के राजा नबूकदनेस्सर की, सेवा न करे, और अपनी गर्दन बाबुल के राजा के जूए के नीचे न रखे, उस जाति को मैं तलवार से और अकाल से और महामारी से दंड दूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, जब तक मैं उसके हाथ से उनका अंत न कर दूँ।
hi.B: जो देश या राज्य बाबुल के राजा नबूकदनेस्सर की सेवा न करे और अपनी गर्दन बाबुल के राजा के जूए के नीचे न रखे, उसे मैं तलवार, अकाल और महामारी से दंड दूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, जब तक मैं उसके हाथ से उसका अंत न कर दूँ।
hi.R: पर मान लो कोई देश या राज्य बाबुल के राजा नबूकदनेस्सर की सेवा करने से इनकार करे, और उसका शासन मानकर अपनी गर्दन उसके जूए के नीचे न रखे। तब मैं उस देश को युद्ध, अकाल और बीमारी से दंड दूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। मैं उसके द्वारा उसे पूरी तरह नष्ट कर दूँगा।

ru.L: И будет: народ и царство, которые не будут служить ему, Навуходоносору, царю Вавилона, и которые не подставят своей шеи под ярмо царя Вавилона, — мечом, и голодом, и мором {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} накажу тот народ, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — пока не истреблю их его рукой.
ru.B: Народ или царство, которые не будут служить Навуходоносору, царю Вавилона, и не подставят шею под ярмо царя Вавилона, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} накажу мечом, голодом и мором, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, пока не истреблю их его рукой.
ru.R: Но если какой-то народ или царство откажется служить Навуходоносору, царю Вавилона, и не подставит шею под его ярмо, не примет его власть, тогда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} накажу этот народ войной, голодом и болезнями, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Через Навуходоносора {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} полностью уничтожу его.

ja.L: [そして]、彼、バビロンの王ネブカドネツァルに仕えず、バビロンの王のくびきの下に自分の首を入れない国や王国があれば、わたしはその国を、剣と飢饉と疫病によって罰する――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。わたしが彼の手によって、それらを滅ぼし尽くすまで[である]。
ja.B: バビロンの王ネブカドネツァルに仕えず、バビロンの王のくびきを首に負わない国や王国があれば、わたしはその国を剣と飢饉と疫病で罰する、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。彼の手によってその国を滅ぼし尽くすまで、わたしは罰し続ける。
ja.R: しかし、ある国や王国が、バビロンの王ネブカドネツァルに仕えることを拒み、彼のくびきを首に負わず、その支配を受け入れないとする。そのとき、わたしは、その国を戦争とききんと疫病で罰する、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。わたしは彼を使って、その国をすっかり滅ぼす。

uk.L: І станеться, [що] народ чи царство, які не служитимуть йому, Навуходоносорові, цареві Вавилону, і які не покладуть своєї шиї під ярмо царя Вавилону, — мечем, і голодом, і моровицею {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} каратиму той народ, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, аж поки не винищу їх його рукою.
uk.B: Кожен народ чи царство, які не служитимуть Навуходоносорові, цареві Вавилону, і не покладуть своєї шиї під ярмо царя Вавилону, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} каратиму мечем, голодом і пошестю, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, аж поки не винищу той народ його рукою.
uk.R: Але припустімо, що якийсь народ чи царство відмовиться служити Навуходоносорові, цареві Вавилону, і не покладе своєї шиї під його ярмо, не прийме його влади. Тоді {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покараю той народ війною, голодом і хворобами, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я вживу його, щоб цілком знищити той народ.

decisions.choice: put its neck under the yoke: submit to his rule
decisions.reason: The picture is the one Jeremiah is wearing (verse 2): a nation that bows its neck to the yoke accepts the king of Babylon as its master.

decisions.choice: punish: deal with a nation for its wrong
decisions.reason: The verb means to attend to someone, and with this preposition it means to call to account and punish (5:9; 9:24). In verse 22 the same verb is used in a good sense.

decisions.choice: until I have finished them off by his hand: the people of that nation destroyed, with Nebuchadnezzar as God's means
decisions.reason: "Them" is the people of the nation; "his hand" is the king of Babylon's. God is the one who acts, and the king is the tool he uses (see verse 6).

decisions.choice: sword, famine and pestilence: war and the hunger and disease that come with siege
decisions.reason: The three come together throughout Jeremiah (14:12; 21:7, 9; 24:10). The third word means a deadly epidemic.

decisions.choice: sword, famine and pestilence (Literal); sword, famine and plague (Balanced); war, famine and disease (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this triad throughout Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: the nation named first and taken up as the object (Balanced); a condition and its result (Readable)
decisions.reason: "It shall be" opens a case. Balanced keeps the nation at the head of the sentence; Readable makes it "suppose ... then" and explains the yoke as accepting his rule.

decisions.choice: меч, голод и мор (L, B); война, голод и болезни (R)
decisions.reason: The three disasters keep the wording set in 24:10 at each level.

decisions.choice: natan tsavvaro be'ol "くびきの下に首を入れる" (L), "くびきを首に負う" (B, R), with R adding "その支配を受け入れる" as the English R; the same forms at 27:11 and 27:12.
alternatives: くびきに首を差し出す
decisions.reason: m1: submit to his rule; 差し出す would suggest an execution.

decisions.choice: The triad "剣と飢饉と疫病" (L, B), "戦争とききんと疫病" (R); ne'um YHWH in the JER forms.
decisions.reason: JER conventions (14:12).

records.literal_gloss: And you, do not listen to your prophets and to your diviners and to your dreams and to your soothsayers and to your sorcerers, who they [are] saying to you, saying: not you will serve [the] king of Babylon.

en.L: And as for you, do not listen to your prophets, or to your diviners, or to your dreams, or to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers, who are speaking to you, saying, "You shall not serve the king of Babylon."
en.B: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your dreamers, your fortune-tellers or your sorcerers, who keep telling you, "You will not serve the king of Babylon."
en.R: So do not listen to your prophets, or to people who use magic to learn secret things, or who tell you their dreams, or who tell fortunes, or who practice witchcraft. They keep telling you, "You will not have to serve the king of Babylon."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, no {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchéis}} a {{plural_you:sus profetas|vuestros profetas}}, ni a {{plural_you:sus adivinos|vuestros adivinos}}, ni a {{plural_you:sus sueños|vuestros sueños}}, ni a {{plural_you:sus agoreros|vuestros agoreros}}, ni a {{plural_you:sus hechiceros|vuestros hechiceros}}, que {{plural_you:les|os}} hablan diciendo: «No {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}} al rey de Babilonia».
es.B: Así que no {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchéis}} a {{plural_you:sus profetas, sus adivinos, sus soñadores, sus agoreros ni sus hechiceros|vuestros profetas, vuestros adivinos, vuestros soñadores, vuestros agoreros ni vuestros hechiceros}}, que siempre {{plural_you:les|os}} están diciendo: «No {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}} al rey de Babilonia».
es.R: Así que no {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchéis}} a {{plural_you:sus profetas|vuestros profetas}}, ni a los que usan la magia para descubrir cosas secretas, ni a los que {{plural_you:les|os}} cuentan sus sueños, ni a los que adivinan el futuro, ni a los que practican la brujería. Siempre {{plural_you:les|os}} están diciendo: «No {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} que servir al rey de Babilonia».

fr.L: Et vous, n’écoutez pas vos prophètes, ni vos devins, ni vos songes, ni vos augures, ni vos sorciers, qui vous disent : ‘Vous ne servirez pas le roi de Babylone.’
fr.B: N’écoutez donc pas vos prophètes, vos devins, vos rêveurs, vos diseurs de bonne aventure ni vos sorciers, qui ne cessent de vous dire : ‘Vous ne servirez pas le roi de Babylone.’
fr.R: N’écoutez donc pas vos prophètes, ni les gens qui utilisent la magie pour découvrir les secrets, ni ceux qui vous racontent leurs rêves, ni ceux qui prédisent l’avenir, ni ceux qui pratiquent la sorcellerie. Ils ne cessent de vous dire : ‘Vous ne serez pas obligés de servir le roi de Babylone.’

sw.L: Nanyi, msiwasikilize manabii wenu, wala waaguzi wenu, wala ndoto zenu, wala wapiga ramli wenu, wala wachawi wenu, wanaowaambia, wakisema, "Hamtamtumikia mfalme wa Babeli."
sw.B: Basi msiwasikilize manabii wenu, waaguzi wenu, waota ndoto wenu, wapiga ramli wenu wala wachawi wenu, wanaoendelea kuwaambia, "Hamtamtumikia mfalme wa Babeli."
sw.R: Basi msiwasikilize manabii wenu, wala watu wanaotumia uganga kujua mambo ya siri, wala wanaowaeleza ndoto zao, wala wanaotabiri bahati, wala wanaofanya uchawi. Wanaendelea kuwaambia, "Hamtalazimika kumtumikia mfalme wa Babeli."

vi.L: Còn các ngươi, đừng nghe các nhà tiên tri của các ngươi, các thầy bói, các giấc mộng, các thầy đoán điềm và các thầy phù thủy của các ngươi, là những kẻ nói với các ngươi rằng: "Các ngươi sẽ không phục dịch vua Ba-by-lôn."
vi.B: Vậy các ngươi đừng nghe các nhà tiên tri, các thầy bói, những kẻ đoán mộng, các thầy đoán vận mệnh hay các thầy phù thủy của các ngươi, là những kẻ cứ nói với các ngươi: "Các ngươi sẽ không phục dịch vua Ba-by-lôn."
vi.R: Vậy các ngươi đừng nghe các nhà tiên tri của mình, cũng đừng nghe những kẻ dùng bùa phép để biết điều bí ẩn, những kẻ kể giấc mộng cho các ngươi, những kẻ đoán vận mệnh hay những kẻ làm phù phép. Chúng cứ nói với các ngươi: "Các ngươi sẽ không phải phục dịch vua Ba-by-lôn."

ko.L: 그러니 너희는 너희 예언자들과 너희 점쟁이들과 너희 꿈과 너희 길흉을 말하는 자들과 너희 마술사들의 말을 듣지 마라. 그들은 너희에게 "너희는 바빌론 왕을 섬기지 않을 것이다." 하고 말한다.
ko.B: 그러니 너희의 예언자들, 점쟁이들, 꿈꾸는 자들, 점술가들, 마술사들의 말을 듣지 마라. 그들은 너희에게 줄곧 "너희는 바빌론 왕을 섬기지 않을 것이다." 하고 말한다.
ko.R: 그러니 너희 예언자들의 말을 듣지 마라. 마술로 숨은 일을 알아낸다는 사람들, 자기 꿈 이야기를 하는 사람들, 운수를 봐 주는 사람들, 마법을 부리는 사람들의 말도 듣지 마라. 그들은 너희에게 줄곧 "너희는 바빌론 왕을 섬기지 않아도 된다." 하고 말한다.

pt.L: E vocês, não ouçam os seus profetas, nem os seus adivinhos, nem os seus sonhos, nem os seus agoureiros, nem os seus feiticeiros, que lhes falam, dizendo: "Vocês não servirão o rei da Babilônia."
pt.B: Portanto, não deem ouvidos aos seus profetas, aos seus adivinhos, aos seus sonhadores, aos que leem a sorte para vocês nem aos seus feiticeiros, que vivem dizendo a vocês: "Vocês não vão servir o rei da Babilônia."
pt.R: Portanto, não escutem os seus profetas, nem as pessoas que usam magia para descobrir coisas escondidas, nem os que contam os seus sonhos, nem os que leem a sorte, nem os que praticam bruxaria. Eles vivem dizendo a vocês: "Vocês não vão ter de servir o rei da Babilônia."

am.L: እናንተም፦ ‘የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ አታገለግሉም’ እያሉ የሚነግሯችሁን ነቢያቶቻችሁን፣ ሟርተኞቻችሁን፣ ሕልሞቻችሁን፣ ጠንቋዮቻችሁንና አስማተኞቻችሁን አትስሙ።
am.B: ስለዚህ፦ ‘የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ አታገለግሉም’ እያሉ ዘወትር የሚነግሯችሁን ነቢያቶቻችሁን፣ ሟርተኞቻችሁን፣ ሕልም አላሚዎቻችሁን፣ ጠንቋዮቻችሁንና አስማተኞቻችሁን አትስሙ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ነቢያቶቻችሁን አትስሙ። ምስጢርን ለማወቅ ሟርት የሚያደርጉትን፣ ሕልማቸውን የሚነግሯችሁን፣ ዕድል የሚነግሩትንና ጥንቆላ የሚያደርጉትን አትስሙ። እነርሱ፦ ‘የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ማገልገል የለባችሁም’ እያሉ ዘወትር ይነግሯችኋል።

hi.L: और तुम, अपने भविष्यद्वक्ताओं की, या अपने भावी कहनेवालों की, या अपने स्वप्नों की, या अपने शुभ-अशुभ बतानेवालों की, या अपने जादूगरों की न सुनना, जो तुमसे कहते हैं, "तुम बाबुल के राजा की सेवा न करोगे।"
hi.B: इसलिए अपने भविष्यद्वक्ताओं, अपने भावी कहनेवालों, अपने स्वप्न देखनेवालों, अपने भविष्य बतानेवालों या अपने जादू-टोना करनेवालों की न सुनना, जो तुमसे कहते रहते हैं, "तुम बाबुल के राजा की सेवा न करोगे।"
hi.R: इसलिए अपने नबियों की बात मत सुनना, न उनकी जो जादू से छिपी बातें जानने का दावा करते हैं, न उनकी जो तुम्हें अपने सपने सुनाते हैं, न उनकी जो भविष्य बताते हैं, न उनकी जो टोना करते हैं। वे तुमसे कहते रहते हैं, "तुम्हें बाबुल के राजा की सेवा नहीं करनी पड़ेगी।"

ru.L: А вы не слушайте ваших пророков, и ваших гадателей, и ваших снов, и ваших предсказателей, и ваших колдунов, которые говорят вам, говоря: ‘Вы не будете служить царю Вавилона.’
ru.B: Поэтому не слушайте ваших пророков, гадателей, толкователей снов, предсказателей и колдунов, которые твердят вам: ‘Вы не будете служить царю Вавилона.’
ru.R: Поэтому не слушайте ваших пророков и тех, кто колдовством узнаёт тайное, кто рассказывает свои сны, кто предсказывает судьбу и кто занимается колдовством. Они всё время говорят вам: ‘Вам не придётся служить царю Вавилона.’

ja.L: あなたがたは、あなたがたの預言者たちにも、占い師たちにも、夢にも、易者たちにも、呪術師たちにも聞くな。彼らはあなたがたに、「あなたがたはバビロンの王に仕えることはない」と言っている。
ja.B: だから、あなたがたの預言者、占い師、夢を見る者、運勢を占う者、呪術師たちに聞き従ってはならない。彼らは、「あなたがたはバビロンの王に仕えることはない」と言い続けている。
ja.R: だから、あなたたちの預言者たちの言うことを聞いてはいけない。まじないで隠れたことを知ろうとする者や、自分の見た夢を語る者や、運勢を占う者や、魔術を行う者の言うことも聞いてはいけない。彼らは、「あなたたちは、バビロンの王に仕えなくてもよい」と言い続けている。

uk.L: А ви не слухайте ваших пророків, і ваших ворожбитів, і ваших снів, і ваших віщунів, і ваших чаклунів, які кажуть вам, говорячи: ‘Ви не служитимете цареві Вавилону’.
uk.B: Тож не слухайте ваших пророків, ворожбитів, снотлумачів, віщунів чи чаклунів, які весь час кажуть вам: ‘Ви не служитимете цареві Вавилону’.
uk.R: Тож не слухайте ваших пророків, ані людей, що чаклунством вивідують таємне, ані тих, хто розповідає вам свої сни, ані ворожок, ані чарівників. Вони весь час кажуть вам: ‘Вам не доведеться служити цареві Вавилону’.

decisions.choice: and you: the kings and their peoples, set against their advisers
decisions.reason: The plural pronoun is written out for emphasis. The message goes to the foreign kings through their envoys.

decisions.choice: diviners, soothsayers, sorcerers: people who claimed to learn hidden things or work magic
decisions.reason: These are words from the list of Deuteronomy 18:10-11, practices the nations relied on and Israel was forbidden (Deuteronomy 18:14). The foreign kings trust them, as Judah trusts its own prophets (verse 14).

decisions.choice: your dreams: dreams claimed as messages from heaven, and those who tell them
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "your dreams", standing in a list of people; the sense is the dreams and those who report them, as in 23:25-32 and 29:8. Some ancient translations read "your dreamers", which gives the same sense.

decisions.choice: diviners, soothsayers, sorcerers (Literal); diviners, fortune-tellers, sorcerers (Balanced); explained (Readable)
decisions.reason: The words used for these practices in Deuteronomy 18:10 and 14. Balanced says "dreamers" because the list names people; Readable says what each one did.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks for the false prophets' words
decisions.reason: These words stand inside the single-quoted message of verses 4-11, so they take double marks again.

decisions.choice: adivinos, agoreros, hechiceros
decisions.reason: The three kinds of people who claimed to learn hidden things or work magic (meaning decision m2) take three distinct Spanish words at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what each did.

decisions.choice: "devins, augures, sorciers" (L); "devins, diseurs de bonne aventure, sorciers" (B)
decisions.reason: The usual French words for these practices; Readable says what each person did, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "thầy bói, thầy đoán điềm, thầy phù thủy" (L); Readable explains each
decisions.reason: Each kind of adviser has its own Vietnamese word at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what each did, as the English does.

decisions.choice: adivinhos, agoureiros, feiticeiros (L); adivinhos, os que leem a sorte, feiticeiros (B); explained (R)
decisions.reason: The practices of Deuteronomy 18:10 and 14 (m2) keep the words Deuteronomy has in Portuguese at each level, so the reader can see that the nations' advisers are the ones the Law forbade.

decisions.choice: diviners "ሟርተኞች"; soothsayers "ጠንቋዮች"; sorcerers "አስማተኞች"
decisions.reason: Three common Amharic words for those who claim hidden knowledge or work magic, one for each Hebrew word; the false prophets' words are a third-level quotation (‘ ’), inside the envoys' message and Jeremiah's report.

decisions.choice: भावी कहनेवाले; शुभ-अशुभ बतानेवाले (L), भविष्य बतानेवाले (B); जादूगर (L), जादू-टोना करनेवाले (B)
decisions.reason: The names of these practices keep the wording of Deuteronomy 18:10, 14 in this translation at each level; Readable says what each did, as Deuteronomy 18 does at R. ज्योतिषी is kept for the magi of Matthew 2.

decisions.choice: гадатели, предсказатели, колдуны
decisions.reason: The practices take the words of Deuteronomy 18:10 in this translation. The false prophets' words stand inside the message in “ ” inside « », so they take the third-level marks ‘ ’, as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: qosemim "占い師たち"; chalomot "夢" (L), "夢を見る者" (B); 'onenim "易者たち" (L), "運勢を占う者" (B); kashshafim "呪術師たち" (L, B); R explains each, as the English R.
decisions.reason: m2, m3; the Hebrew words for the kinds of diviner are hard to tell apart.

decisions.choice: The false prophets' words in 「」 inside the envoys' 『』; the message's prohibitions "聞くな" (L), "聞き従ってはならない" (B), "聞いてはいけない" (R).
decisions.reason: The JER rule for commands in a message.

source.text: כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖ם נִבְּאִ֣ים לָכֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן הַרְחִ֤יק אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵעַ֣ל אַדְמַתְכֶ֔ם וְהִדַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם וַאֲבַדְתֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For falsehood they [are] prophesying to you, so as to remove far you from upon your land, and I will drive out you and you will perish.

en.L: For they are prophesying a lie to you, so as to remove you far from your land, and I will drive you out, and you will perish.
en.B: They are prophesying a lie to you, and it will only lead to your being taken far from your land. I will drive you out, and you will perish.
en.R: What they tell you is a lie. It will only get you taken far away from your land. I will drive you out, and you will die.

es.L: Porque mentira {{plural_you:les|os}} profetizan, para {{plural_you:alejarlos|alejaros}} de {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}, y yo {{plural_you:los|os}} echaré y {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}}.
es.B: Lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} profetizan es mentira, y solo servirá para que {{plural_you:los|os}} lleven lejos de {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}. Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} echaré, y {{plural_you:perecerán|pereceréis}}.
es.R: Lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} dicen es mentira. Solo servirá para que {{plural_you:se los lleven|os lleven}} lejos de {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}. Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} echaré, y {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}}.

fr.L: Car c’est le mensonge qu’ils vous prophétisent, pour vous éloigner de votre terre, et je vous chasserai, et vous périrez.
fr.B: Ce qu’ils vous prophétisent est un mensonge, qui n’aboutira qu’à vous faire emmener loin de votre pays. Je vous chasserai, et vous périrez.
fr.R: Ce qu’ils vous disent est un mensonge. Cela vous fera seulement emmener loin de votre pays. Je vous chasserai, et vous mourrez.

sw.L: Kwa maana wanawatabiria uongo, ili kuwahamisha mbali na nchi yenu, nami nitawafukuza, nanyi mtaangamia.
sw.B: Wanawatabiria uongo, nao utawaletea tu kuhamishwa mbali na nchi yenu. Nitawafukuza, nanyi mtaangamia.
sw.R: Wanayowaambia ni uongo. Utawasababisha tu kuchukuliwa mbali na nchi yenu. Nitawafukuza, nanyi mtakufa.

vi.L: Vì chúng nói tiên tri giả dối cho các ngươi, khiến các ngươi bị đem đi xa khỏi đất mình, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đuổi các ngươi đi, và các ngươi sẽ bị diệt vong.
vi.B: Chúng nói tiên tri dối trá cho các ngươi, và điều đó chỉ khiến các ngươi bị đem đi xa khỏi đất mình. Ta sẽ đuổi các ngươi đi, và các ngươi sẽ bị diệt vong.
vi.R: Điều chúng nói với các ngươi là dối trá. Lời ấy chỉ khiến các ngươi bị đem đi xa khỏi đất mình. Ta sẽ đuổi các ngươi đi, và các ngươi sẽ chết.

ko.L: 그들이 너희에게 거짓을 예언하여, 너희를 너희 땅에서 멀리 옮겨지게 하고, 내가 너희를 쫓아내어 너희가 멸망하게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 너희에게 거짓을 예언하고 있다. 그 결과 너희는 너희 땅에서 멀리 끌려가게 될 뿐이다. 내가 너희를 쫓아낼 것이고, 너희는 멸망할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 너희에게 하는 말은 거짓말이다. 그 말을 들으면 너희는 너희 땅에서 멀리 끌려가게 될 뿐이다. 내가 너희를 쫓아낼 것이고, 너희는 죽을 것이다.

pt.L: Pois eles lhes profetizam mentira, para afastar vocês para longe da sua terra, e eu os expulsarei, e vocês perecerão.
pt.B: Eles profetizam mentiras a vocês, e isso só vai fazer que vocês sejam levados para longe da sua terra. Eu os expulsarei, e vocês perecerão.
pt.R: O que eles dizem a vocês é mentira. Isso só vai fazer vocês serem levados para longe da sua terra. Eu vou expulsar vocês, e vocês vão morrer.

am.L: ከምድራችሁ ያርቋችሁ ዘንድ ሐሰትን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና፤ እኔም አሳድዳችኋለሁ፤ እናንተም ትጠፋላችሁ።
am.B: የሚናገሩላችሁ የሐሰት ትንቢት ነው፤ ይህም ከምድራችሁ ርቃችሁ እንድትወሰዱ ብቻ ያደርጋል። እኔም አሳድዳችኋለሁ፤ ትጠፋላችሁም።
am.R: የሚነግሯችሁ ውሸት ነው። ውሸታቸው ከምድራችሁ ርቃችሁ እንድትወሰዱ ብቻ ያደርጋል። እኔም አሳድዳችኋለሁ፤ ትሞታላችሁም።

hi.L: क्योंकि वे तुमसे झूठी भविष्यवाणी करते हैं, जिसका फल यह होगा कि तुम अपने देश से दूर कर दिए जाओगे, और मैं तुम्हें निकाल दूँगा, और तुम नाश हो जाओगे।
hi.B: वे तुमसे झूठी भविष्यवाणी करते हैं, और उसका परिणाम केवल यह होगा कि तुम अपने देश से दूर ले जाए जाओगे। मैं तुम्हें निकाल दूँगा, और तुम नाश हो जाओगे।
hi.R: जो वे तुमसे कहते हैं, वह झूठ है। उससे बस इतना होगा कि तुम अपने देश से दूर ले जाए जाओगे। मैं तुम्हें निकाल दूँगा, और तुम मर जाओगे।

ru.L: Ведь ложь они пророчествуют вам, чтобы удалить вас от вашей земли, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изгоню вас, и вы погибнете.
ru.B: Они пророчествуют вам ложь, и это лишь приведёт к тому, что вас уведут далеко от вашей земли. Я изгоню вас, и вы погибнете.
ru.R: То, что они говорят вам, — ложь. Из-за неё вас уведут далеко от вашей земли. Я изгоню вас, и вы умрёте.

ja.L: 彼らはあなたがたに偽りを預言している。それは、あなたがたをあなたがたの土地から遠く離れさせることになり、わたしはあなたがたを追いやり、あなたがたは滅びる。
ja.B: 彼らは、あなたがたに偽りを預言している。それは、あなたがたが自分の土地から遠く連れ去られる結果にしかならない。わたしはあなたがたを追いやり、あなたがたは滅びる。
ja.R: 彼らが言っていることはうそだ。それを聞けば、あなたたちは自分の土地から遠く連れて行かれるだけだ。わたしはあなたたちを追い出し、あなたたちは死ぬ。

uk.L: Бо вони пророкують вам неправду, щоб віддалити вас від вашої землі, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вижену вас, і ви загинете.
uk.B: Вони пророкують вам неправду, і це лише призведе до того, що вас заберуть далеко з вашої землі. Я вижену вас, і ви загинете.
uk.R: Те, що вони вам кажуть, — неправда. Через неї вас лише заберуть далеко з вашої землі. Я вижену вас, і ви помрете.

decisions.choice: so as to remove you: the result, not the prophets' aim
decisions.reason: The word can express purpose, but here it gives the outcome: listening to their lies leads to exile. The prophets do not want the people removed; it is what their message will bring about.

decisions.choice: a lie: a message that is false and not from God
decisions.reason: "Lie" is a key word of chapters 27-29 (verses 14, 15, 16; 28:15; 29:9, 21). The prophets are not mistaken guessers; they speak what God has not said.

decisions.choice: it will only lead to (Balanced); it will only get you (Readable)
decisions.reason: These wordings give the sense of result (see m1).

decisions.choice: lema'an harchiq as a result, "…ことになり" (L), "結果にしかならない" (B), "…だけだ" (R) (m1); hiddachti "追いやる" (L, B), "追い出す" (R).
decisions.reason: m1: the result, not the prophets' aim.

source.text: וְהַגּ֗וֹי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבִ֧יא אֶת־צַוָּאר֛וֹ בְּעֹ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וַֽעֲבָד֑וֹ וְהִנַּחְתִּ֤יו עַל־אַדְמָתוֹ֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וַֽעֲבָדָ֖הּ וְיָ֥שַׁב בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the nation which will bring its neck into [the] yoke of [the] king of Babylon and serve him, and I will leave it on its land, declaration of Yahweh, and it will work it and dwell in it.

en.L: But the nation that brings its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will let it remain on its own land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and it will work it and live in it.'"
en.B: But any nation that bows its neck to the king of Babylon's yoke and serves him, I will leave on its own land, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They will farm it and live there.'"
en.R: But if a nation accepts the rule of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will let it stay in its own land, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Its people will farm the land and live there.'"

es.L: Pero a la nación que meta su cuello bajo el yugo del rey de Babilonia y le sirva, la dejaré en su propia tierra, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y la cultivará y habitará en ella”».
es.B: Pero a toda nación que doble su cuello bajo el yugo del rey de Babilonia y le sirva, la dejaré en su propia tierra, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. La cultivarán y vivirán en ella”».
es.R: Pero si una nación acepta el gobierno del rey de Babilonia y le sirve, la dejaré quedarse en su propia tierra, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Su gente cultivará la tierra y vivirá allí”».

fr.L: Mais la nation qui fera entrer son cou sous le joug du roi de Babylone et le servira, je la laisserai sur sa terre, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et elle la cultivera et y habitera.” »
fr.B: Mais la nation qui pliera le cou sous le joug du roi de Babylone et le servira, je la laisserai sur son sol, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ses habitants le cultiveront et y vivront.” »
fr.R: Mais si une nation accepte l’autorité du roi de Babylone et le sert, je la laisserai dans son pays, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ses habitants cultiveront la terre et y vivront.” »

sw.L: Lakini taifa litakalotia shingo yake chini ya nira ya mfalme wa Babeli na kumtumikia, nitaliacha katika nchi yake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nalo litailima na kukaa ndani yake.'"
sw.B: Lakini taifa lolote litakaloinamisha shingo yake chini ya nira ya mfalme wa Babeli na kumtumikia, nitaliacha katika nchi yake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu wake wataliima na kuishi humo.'"
sw.R: Lakini taifa likikubali utawala wa mfalme wa Babeli na kumtumikia, nitaliacha libaki katika nchi yake, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu wake watalima nchi hiyo na kuishi humo.'"

vi.L: Nhưng dân tộc nào đưa cổ mình vào ách của vua Ba-by-lôn và phục dịch vua ấy, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ để nó ở lại trên đất mình, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và nó sẽ cày cấy đất ấy và ở tại đó.'"
vi.B: Nhưng dân tộc nào chịu cúi cổ dưới ách của vua Ba-by-lôn và phục dịch vua ấy, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ để dân tộc ấy ở lại trên đất mình, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Họ sẽ cày cấy đất ấy và sống tại đó.'"
vi.R: Nhưng nếu dân tộc nào chịu để vua Ba-by-lôn cai trị và phục dịch vua ấy, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ để dân tộc ấy ở lại trên đất mình, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Dân của nước ấy sẽ cày cấy đất đai và sống tại đó.'"

ko.L: 그러나 바빌론 왕의 멍에에 자기 목을 넣고 그를 섬기는 민족은, 내가 그 민족을 자기 땅에 남아 있게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그들이 그 땅을 갈며 거기에서 살 것이다.'"
ko.B: 그러나 바빌론 왕의 멍에를 목에 메고 그를 섬기는 민족은 내가 자기 땅에 그대로 머물게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그들은 그 땅을 일구며 거기에서 살 것이다.'"
ko.R: 그러나 어떤 민족이 바빌론 왕의 다스림을 받아들이고 그를 섬기면, 나는 그 민족이 자기 땅에 머물러 살게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그 백성은 그 땅에서 농사를 지으며 살 것이다.'"

pt.L: Mas a nação que puser o seu pescoço debaixo do jugo do rei da Babilônia e o servir, eu a deixarei ficar na sua [própria] terra, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e ela a cultivará e habitará nela.'"
pt.B: Mas a nação que curvar o pescoço ao jugo do rei da Babilônia e o servir, eu a deixarei na sua própria terra, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Os seus habitantes vão cultivá-la e morar nela.'"
pt.R: Mas, se uma nação aceitar o governo do rei da Babilônia e o servir, vou deixá-la ficar na sua própria terra, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. O povo dela vai cultivar a terra e morar ali.'"

am.L: አንገቱን ግን ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች የሚያስገባውንና የሚያገለግለውን ሕዝብ በምድሩ ላይ እተወዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ያርሳታል፤ ይኖርባታልም።”»
am.B: ነገር ግን አንገቱን ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር ዝቅ አድርጎ የሚያገለግለውን ሕዝብ ሁሉ በገዛ ምድሩ ላይ እተወዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። እነርሱም ያርሷታል፤ በእርሷም ይኖራሉ።”»
am.R: ነገር ግን አንድ ሕዝብ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ አገዛዝ ተቀብሎ ቢያገለግለው፣ በገዛ ምድሩ እንዲኖር እተወዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ሕዝቡም ምድሪቱን ያርሳል፤ በዚያም ይኖራል።”»

hi.L: पर जो जाति अपनी गर्दन बाबुल के राजा के जूए के नीचे लाए और उसकी सेवा करे, उसे मैं उसकी अपनी भूमि पर रहने दूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और वह उसमें खेती करेगी और उसमें बसी रहेगी।'"
hi.B: पर जो देश अपनी गर्दन बाबुल के राजा के जूए के आगे झुकाए और उसकी सेवा करे, उसे मैं उसकी अपनी भूमि पर रहने दूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। उसके लोग उसमें खेती करेंगे और वहीं बसे रहेंगे।'"
hi.R: पर यदि कोई देश बाबुल के राजा का शासन मान ले और उसकी सेवा करे, तो मैं उसे उसके अपने देश में रहने दूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। उसके लोग अपनी भूमि पर खेती करेंगे और वहीं रहेंगे।'"

ru.L: А народ, который подставит свою шею под ярмо царя Вавилона и будет служить ему, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} оставлю на его земле, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — и он будет обрабатывать её и жить на ней.”»
ru.B: Но народ, который склонит шею под ярмо царя Вавилона и будет служить ему, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} оставлю на его земле, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Они будут возделывать её и жить на ней.”»
ru.R: Но если народ примет власть царя Вавилона и будет служить ему, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} позволю ему остаться в своей земле, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Его люди будут возделывать землю и жить там.”»

ja.L: しかし、自分の首をバビロンの王のくびきの下に入れて彼に仕える国は、わたしはそれを、その土地にとどまらせる――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。それはその土地を耕し、そこに住む。』」
ja.B: しかし、バビロンの王のくびきを首に負って彼に仕える国は、わたしがその国を自分の土地にとどまらせる、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。その民はその土地を耕し、そこに住む。』」
ja.R: しかし、ある国がバビロンの王の支配を受け入れ、彼に仕えるなら、わたしはその国を自分の土地にとどまらせる、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。その国の人々は、その土地を耕し、そこに住み続ける。』」

uk.L: А народ, який підставить свою шию під ярмо царя Вавилону і служитиме йому, — його {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} залишу на його землі, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і він оброблятиме її і житиме на ній”».
uk.B: Але кожен народ, що схилить шию під ярмо царя Вавилону і служитиме йому, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} залишу на його власній землі, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Вони оброблятимуть її і житимуть там”».
uk.R: Але якщо народ прийме владу царя Вавилону і служитиме йому, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам йому залишитися на його власній землі, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Його люди оброблятимуть землю і житимуть там”».

decisions.choice: work it: farm the land
decisions.reason: The verb is the same as "serve". Used of the ground it means to till it (Genesis 2:5; 4:2). The words play on each other: the nation that serves the king of Babylon will go on working its own land.

decisions.choice: I will leave it on its land: the promise set against the threat of verse 10
decisions.reason: Submission means staying in the land; refusal means being driven out. The message to the kings ends here.

decisions.choice: farm; they, its people (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "farm" for working the land, and "they" for the nation's people.

decisions.choice: single and double quotation marks closed
decisions.reason: The message to the envoys (from verse 4) and God's words to Jeremiah (from verse 2) both end here.

decisions.choice: The yoke forms of 27:8 ("くびきの下に…入れる" L, "くびきを首に負う" B, "支配を受け入れ" R); 'avadah "耕す" (m1).
』」 close the envoys' message and God's words to Jeremiah.
decisions.reason: Quotation structure as the English.
